units: Orl. I, 1 הנוטע לס׳ he that plants for the sake of forming a hedge (not for the fruit); a. fr.—Trnsf. (cmp. גֶּדֶר) guard, preventive measure, protection.

<cite ref="Niddah 3b:23">Nidd. 3ᵇ</cite> … <he>ומיהו עשה ס׳ לדבריך דעבדינן ס׳</he> but at least set a guard to thy words (add a restriction), for wherein does this case differ from other Biblical laws around which we (the Rabbis) place a fence? Y. ib. I, beg. 48ᵈ.
<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 1:7">Ab. d’R. N. ch. I</cite>, v. <cite ref="O00242"><he>סוּג</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:1">Ab. I, 1</cite> <he>עשו ס׳ לתורה</he> make a fence around the Law.

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:13">Ib. III, 13</cite> <he>מסורת ס׳ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M01884"><he>מַסּוֹרֶת</he></cite>; <he>מעשרות ס׳ לעושר</he> tithe-giving is a preserver of wealth; <he>נדרים ס׳ וכ׳</he> vows are a help to self-control; <he>ס׳ לחכמה וכ׳</he> a protection of wisdom is silence; a. fr.
